statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2026-0440: Astral ended maintenance of the astral-tokio-tar crate on November 3, 2026, and every release is deprecated. RustSec marks every astral-tokio-tar release as affected, reports no vulnerability in it and lists no patched version: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0440.html and https://github.com/astral-sh/tokio-tar/pull/130. We listed the contents of every build-dev apk in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository, for x86_64 and aarch64 (91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to 2.30.0-r0, 181 apks, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only), each checked against its index checksum. The repository lists 2.19.1-r1 three times per architecture with different checksums; we read the copy it serves. Each build-dev apk holds one regular file, /usr/bin/build, plus its directories and no symlinks, and /usr/bin/build is a Go program in every build (it carries Go build information). No build of build-dev ships uv or any other Rust program, so the crate is not in this package.

statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0440: Astral ended maintenance of the astral-tokio-tar crate on November 3, 2026, and every release is deprecated. RustSec marks every astral-tokio-tar release as affected, reports no vulnerability in it and lists no patched version: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0440.html and https://github.com/astral-sh/tokio-tar/pull/130. We listed the contents of every build-fips apk in the Alpine 3.23 index of the authenticated DHI Alpine security repository, where the FIPS packages are published, for x86_64 and aarch64 (91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to 2.30.0-r0, 181 apks, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only), each checked against its index checksum. The repository lists 2.19.1-r1 three times per architecture with different checksums; we read the copy it serves. build-fips carries the Go program /usr/bin/build in every build, from 2.26.2-r1 also the Go program /opt/docker/dhi/yq and from 2.28.0-r1 also the Go program /usr/bin/dhi-source. From 2.27.1-r1 to 2.30.0-r0 (12 versions) it also carries /opt/docker/dhi/uv, the uv 0.13.6 Rust program; these builds hold five distinct uv binaries per architecture, and every shipped copy matches one of them by SHA-256. The builds before 2.27.1-r1 carry no Rust program. The crate list that cargo-auditable embeds in each uv binary names astral-tokio-tar 0.7.0, used by uv's uv-extract, uv-build-backend and uv-publish crates, and every distinct uv binary contains astral-tokio-tar-0.7.0/src source paths (6 times each), so the crate's code is compiled into uv. No published build replaces it, so every build from 2.27.1-r1 on contains the unmaintained crate.
